about: The host bridge's actions for what only macOS does (M2m; the login item, the office's window, the folder panel and the Summary key: FXC1b; the portable office's keys, the Swift engine's own Keychain items, and when you're back at the Mac: M7VIEW; the office's keys from anywhere: KSC, and in setup's facts the keys held now and each key's name on the layout in use, a French AZERTY's here: FXKSC), which processes work in a folder or name a session (M5c, read only: Let go's and Take over's check on the Go core), T3 Code's app found and opened by its bundle id and a hire's thread by its link (M5c, C4 A1), the Grok Bot app's bots for the core to find and the jukebox (FXC2), the GM's tiling: the Mac's screens, the hires' windows moved by the tty each shows and the office's window put under them (M7GAPC, the AppleScript only ever a stand-in's), and the install line of the self-test and its Move to Applications (FXC1c: only the app knows where its bundle is), and the phone's text into a Mac terminal (I5, IGL: the Swift engine's own Deck.typePhoneWords; the app asks the core the desk's state on the same connection, where the Swift engine looks at its own sessions, which no case here shows: the held one is the core saying it's asking; phone-text.json has the whole table; and the API-key account for a hire, M4c, with a stand-in key; the GM's token kept between runs in the Swift engine's own item, M7TOK, stand-in tokens; the office's mic dictating, M7GAPA; and the record key Smolcorp's records are sealed with, SK1, stand-in keys; the Macs this one joined for floors, with their keys, FL0, stand-in keys:this Mac's microphone recording for a desk, what it heard cleaned up as the core says, and the text typed in only while its agent is in front): each request as the Go core sends it (desktop/hostbridge.go, without its token) and the Mac app's answer (Sources/AgentDeck/HostBridge.swift), on the stand-ins both tests use. desktop/hostbridge_test.go checks the core asks exactly this and reads the answer; HostBridgeTests.swift checks the app answers exactly this.
